messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Metformin is prescribed to manage polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).
Metformin improves how the body responds to insulin.
PCOS affects about 1 in 10 women of reproductive age.
PCOS is often marked by insulin resistance.
In insulin resistance, the body doesn't respond well to insulin.
This lack of response prompts the pancreas to produce more insulin.
This excess insulin drives up androgen production.
Androgen is a male hormone.
This process worsens symptoms like irregular periods, infertility, acne, and excess hair growth.
Metformin helps by lowering insulin levels.
Metformin helps by decreasing the liver's glucose production.
Metformin helps by improving glucose uptake by muscles.
Metformin helps by reducing circulating androgen levels.
Reducing circulating androgen levels can support more regular ovulation.
Reducing circulating androgen levels can support more regular menstrual cycles.
Metformin is not FDA-approved to treat PCOS.
Metformin is widely prescribed as an off-label treatment.
Metformin is prescribed particularly for those with insulin resistance.
Triplet: ["PCOS", "marked by", "insulin resistance"]

The relation 'marked by' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition is commonly associated with or characterized by the specified symptom or feature.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has symptom': The condition specified by the subject entity is associated with the symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'caused by': The subject condition or symptom is caused by the object condition or factor.
C. 'is common': The subject entity is frequently encountered or prevalent as a condition or situation.
D. 'occurs in': The subject medical condition is observed or experienced by the group of individuals specified by the object entity.
E. 'related to': The subject entity is associated with or connected to the medical condition or entity specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
